observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, positioning self as one entitled to order what the other must discard.
Bare imperative verb enacts authority-ranking: speaker issues a deletion command without hedge or justification, performing hierarchical control over what the recipient retains.

mints.title: Remove all knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker commanding the recipient to discard or forget information, enacting authority over what the other must retain?
